mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 71 degrees with mainly clear skies over Reddan Soccer Park. We are under a Waning Gibbous moon and if you are up early, look to the northwest near Verona High School at 5:03 AM to catch the ISS as it glides toward Fitchburg for 6 minutes.

Mayor Luke Diaz has officially proclaimed September 2026 as Hunger Action Month in Verona. This effort highlights that 1 in 8 residents in Southwest Wisconsin face food insecurity and encourages the community to volunteer and donate to local food banks to bridge the gap in nutrition security.

We have a full schedule starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to Tuesday, visit the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or catch live music and trivia throughout the week at local favorites.

In a report from August 22nd, officers responded to a vehicle crash on Enterprise Drive where a driver was cited for several violations, including inattentive driving and failure to install an ignition interlock device.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Turtle Dove. The store opens today at 10:00 AM so make sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
